title: Microsoft Edge: Unsubscribe button on website notifications
summary: The roadmap facts and the documented notification policy paths and registry settings check out. Two non-blocking corrections remain: the cost rationale attributes estimated support effort to the roadmap, and the fallback explanation overstates which reference pages contain it.

claims.where: Governance controls: paragraph beginning 'The three policies'
claims.claim: When NotificationsBlockedForUrls is unset, the global default comes from DefaultNotificationsSetting if set, otherwise personal configuration.
claims.quote: If you don't set this policy, the global default value is used for all sites. This default value is from the DefaultNotificationsSetting policy if it's set, or from the user's personal configuration.
claims.fix: Replace 'Each page says that when' with 'The NotificationsAllowedForUrls and NotificationsBlockedForUrls reference pages say that when'. The DefaultNotificationsSetting page does not contain this fallback statement.

claims.claim: When NotificationsAllowedForUrls is unset, the global default comes from DefaultNotificationsSetting if set, otherwise personal configuration.
claims.quote: If you don't set this policy, the global default value is used for all sites. This default value is from the DefaultNotificationsSetting policy if set, or from the user's personal configuration.
